name: Write scripts for various video platforms
description: Users requested the creation of video scripts for a diverse range of platforms, including YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and television, covering topics such as historical figures, product promotions, educational lessons, and personal narratives. Many requests specified particular formats, such as short-form content or detailed narration with visual cues, while others focused on adapting existing text or analyzing script performance.
